s2_contexts: This would prevent air to escape inside the container and thus causing a vacuum that affects negatively the continuous supply of powder (El Kassem et al. 2020a).

Flow problems result in inaccurate metering and dosing, product degradation, downtime, lost production hours, and more importantly low-
quality drugs that may pose health risks to end-users, i.e. patients (El Kassem et al. 2020b).

The correlations between critical material attributes, critical process parameters, and critical quality attributes for auger dosing of ten different powders were thoroughly investigated in a previous study (El Kassem et al. 2020a).

One of the most important aspects of designing the auger geometry is having a conical form which proved in other studies (El Kassem et al. 2020a) to have its positive influence on the dosing accuracy over the standard straight form.
The material characterization methods and auger dosing experimental results of the studied powders, except for Paracetamol, were performed in a previous study (El Kassem et al. 2020a).
The conical geometry aided in forwarding the powder downwards into the dosing tube and thus helped in consistently having a high powder mass concentration around the auger (El Kassem et al. 2020a).
